description: Encodes eight gates into the one signal an ESX-8GT expander decodes, one bit per gate

inputs.text: Turns on the ESX-8GT output of the same number; the bit is set at 1V and released below 0.5V

outputs.text: The encoded stream for the ESX-8GT; patch it to an input of an ES-5 Encoder or ES-4(0) Encoder

notes: The output is an encoded stream and not a voltage: patch it to an input of an ES-5 Encoder or ES-4(0) Encoder, and nothing reaches an ESX-8GT without that.
The ES-5 Encoder or ES-4(0) Encoder outputs in turn go to the audio interface channels wired to the hardware.

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
